violated_contract: Every iPhone app target must run its Embed Frameworks copy phase before Flutter's Thin Binary script. Thin Binary consumes the processed Info.plist, and embedding a framework after it makes the framework copy depend on Thin Binary, so Xcode stops with "Cycle inside <target>". RunnerRayBanDat ran Thin Binary first; once it embedded OnDeviceParakeet.framework, every Ray-Ban DAT simulator build on main failed while the default Runner target, which already used the safe order, kept building.
canonical_prevention: Keep Embed Frameworks ahead of Thin Binary in both Runner and RunnerRayBanDat, and assert that order for every iPhone target in the Xcode graph contract test, so adding a target or an embedded framework cannot reintroduce the cycle unnoticed.
